facts.name: Pezcow
facts.label: Pezcow
facts.tagline: A family-owned food truck at Mitote Food Park in Santa Rosa with Mexican dishes from the land and sea: tacos piratas, fish tacos, coctel de camarón, ceviche and huachinango, plus tlayudas, machetes, memelitas and tacos al pastor.
facts.contactOnly: Mexican seafood and land dishes from their truck at Mitote Food Park: tacos piratas, fish tacos, coctel de camarón, ceviche, camarones a la diabla, quesadilla marina, tlayudas, machetes, tortas and tacos. Their menu is published without prices, so call the truck to order for pickup.
facts.address: Mitote Food Park, 665 Sebastopol Rd, Santa Rosa, CA 95407
facts.siteNote: Pickup orders by phone at the truck, (707) 727-3483. Pezcow also runs a restaurant in Windsor, at 8465 Old Redwood Hwy #510.
